name: Jeinimeni portal to Valle Hermoso refugio (one night, turn back at km 69)
dist: about 32 km return over 2 days (16 km each way)
terrain: T2/T3 marked trail, bridges to km 59, fords km 63-69 (knee at most in 2025-26 reports), hazards: ford, navigation
cost: park entry about CLP 11,400 pp; camping CLP 0-10,000 pp (reports differ); fuel for about 120 km gravel return from Chile Chico
caution: do not cross if water is brown or after rain; turn back at km 69 (fords beyond are mid-thigh); X-753 fords near the lake; camp coordinates are estimates; trail washed out at -46.8897,-72.1647 (use OSM detour)
why: Valle Hermoso glacier valley, the real Aviles scenery; the Lago Verde day walk only shows the lake

why: fallback if the rivers are too high for Valle Hermoso
